about: Held out: written after rules.uncued was fixed on uncued_phrases.json, to see what it does on phrasing it wasn't written against. Run once before any change (gate_heldout.py writes gate_heldout.out.txt). No real people's names; none has a cue. `want`: fix, todo or idea to keep; negatives to let go.
